newsitem.title: USA: Albank to lend $55 mln under consent decree.
newsitem.headline: Albank to lend $55 mln under consent decree.

text.p: Albank Financial Corp said Wednesday that under a federal consent decree, it will make $55 million in below-market-rate mortgages in southern Westchester County, New York, and seven nearby Connecticut cities, to resolve allegations of racial bias in its mortgage practices.
The decree, said the bank, relates to its decision not to purchase mortgages in areas with large proportions of minority residents, but does not constitute an admission of guilt.
The bank said it "categorically denies any and all allegations that ALBANK has intentionally violated fair lending or equal credit opportunity laws.
"We are disappointed that the Department of Justice failed to recognize the legitimate and non-discriminatory business and economic reasons for our mortgage purchase criteria."

The bank said it stopped buying mortgages in Connecticut because the affected areas were in economic decline, and limited its purchases to northern Westchester because of its similarity to Albank's home market in upstate New York.
However, the bank said the discount mortgages will be available for five years, and that it will also contribute $700,000 to homebuyers education programs.
